approval.approved_statement: The maintainer explicitly authorized deployment of the DJConnect central API 4.0.0-rc.2 candidate to Cloudflare Workers production, using candidate e8b345eafb3b2c04b60d19ef30a85317be4fc200 and its immutable release artifact, followed by the matching public health smoke verification.
approval.effect: This approval authorizes only the API candidate and the cloudflare_workers_production target. It does not authorize a stable release, public product promotion, client-store submission, or deployment of any other Platform 4.0 component.

constraints: The candidate is an internal prerelease and must not be represented as a stable or public product release.
The Cloudflare Worker deployment and public health smoke remain separately dispatched and must use the exact artifact binding above.
The release is valid only after the matching post-deployment smoke confirms the public health version and release SHA.
next_authorized_action: Dispatch the Cloudflare Workers production deployment, then its matching post-deployment smoke, for the exact binding above.
